history: Suzhou was founded in 514 BC and its city site has not moved in 2,500 years. Nine gardens including the Humble Administrator's and the Lingering Garden are World Heritage — 'Jiangnan's gardens rule the world; Suzhou's rule Jiangnan'. Pingtan and Kunqu in soft Wu tones, silk and embroidery of heavenly skill, and Hanshan Temple's bell of 'A Night Mooring by Maple Bridge' have sounded for a thousand years.
importance: City of Gardens · Paradise on Earth
foods: Mandarin-fish shaped like a squirrel in sweet-sour sauce — king of Suzhou cuisine.
Autumn hairy crab — golden roe when 'autumn winds rise'.
Fengzhen pork noodles — clear broth, white noodles.
Yaba pan-fried buns — thin skin, hot soup.
Pan Yulin's sweet red-bean porridge — a childhood taste.
scenes: Head of China's four great gardens — World Heritage.
'Not visiting Tiger Hill is a pity' — Suzhou's leaning pagoda.
An 800-year old lane where waterways and streets run parallel.
One of the four great gardens — the Guanyun Peak limestone.
The temple of 'the midnight bell reaches my boat'.
'First water town of China' — the Twin Bridges scene.
A modern lakeside skyline and Ferris wheel.
The model of small gardens — night tours with pingtan.
